summary: The accumulator's capacity check excluded the terminating sentinel, although the copied slice included it. A 12-byte frame fed to an 11-byte accumulator therefore passed the check and panicked on out-of-bounds slicing. The fix checks take.len(), including the sentinel, so the accumulator returns FeedResult::OverFull. The fix adds the selected regression test. This plan has not been executed.
expected_failure: range end index 12 out of range for slice of length 11
